description.en: 400 practical headwords with examples, patterns and selected everyday senses. Assumes basic grammar and function words. Practise conversations alongside vocabulary; no 95% coverage or fluency guarantee.
description.zh: 400 個實用核心字，配例句、搭配同精選日常用法。需要先識基本文法及組句字，再配合情境對答練習；唔代表涵蓋 95% 對話或保證流利。

level.zh: 已有基本組句能力，進一步練日常口語（非 CEFR 認證）

entries.englishDefinition: To exist, describe someone or something, or form continuous and passive sentences.
chineseMeanings: 係；喺；處於某狀態；助動詞

examples.english: I am a teacher.
My brother is a nurse.
She is at home.
The keys are on the table.
We are having lunch.
She is cooking dinner.
The room is cleaned every day.
examples.chinese: 【被動用法】間房每日都有人清潔。

examples.english: The tickets are checked at the door.
examples.chinese: 【被動用法】入門口嗰陣會有人查飛。

examples.english: I am tired today.
The food is ready.
examples.chinese: 【處於某狀態】啲食物準備好喇。

entries.englishDefinition: To own or experience something; also used for duties and completed actions.
chineseMeanings: 有；經歷；食／飲；必須；助動詞

examples.english: I have a car.
Do you have a pen I can borrow?
I'm having a bad day.
examples.chinese: 【經歷；有某感覺／問題】我今日過得唔順。

examples.english: She has a headache today.
examples.chinese: 【經歷；有某感覺／問題】佢今日頭痛。

examples.english: Let's have lunch.
We had sandwiches for lunch.
I had a shower.
We have a meeting at ten.
I have to go.
You have to show your ticket here.
I had my phone repaired.
examples.chinese: 【叫人幫你做】我搵人整咗部電話。

examples.english: We had the kitchen painted last week.
examples.chinese: 【叫人幫你做】我哋上星期搵人油咗個廚房。

examples.english: I have already eaten.
examples.chinese: 【助動詞：連接過去同而家】我已經食咗嘢。
examples.meaning: 助動詞：連接過去同而家

examples.english: She has finished her homework.
examples.chinese: 【助動詞：連接過去同而家】佢做完功課喇。
examples.meaning: 助動詞：連接過去同而家

examples.english: Can I have some water?
We had coffee after lunch.

entries.englishDefinition: To perform an action; also used to form questions and negatives.
chineseMeanings: 做；足夠；表現／進展；助動詞

examples.english: I need to do some work.
Who will do the dishes tonight?
Don't do that.
If you need to leave, do so now.
examples.chinese: 【代替前面動作】如果你要走，就而家走啦。

examples.english: This will do.
Will this small bag do?
How are you doing?
She is doing well at school.
examples.chinese: 【表現；進展】佢喺學校表現幾好。

examples.english: Do you work here?
examples.chinese: 【助動詞：組成問句】你喺度返工㗎？

examples.english: Do they live near you?
examples.chinese: 【助動詞：組成問句】佢哋係咪住喺你附近？

examples.english: I do not know.
We do not need any help.
examples.chinese: 【助動詞：組成否定句】我哋唔需要幫手。

entries.englishDefinition: To speak words.

examples.english: What did she say to you?
Please say your name slowly.
She said that she was tired.
He said he would call tonight.

entries.englishDefinition: To receive, obtain, become, arrive, understand, fetch, buy, catch an illness, or cause something to happen; also used in common phrasal verbs.
chineseMeanings: 收到；得到；變得；到達；明白；攞／買；患病；使某事發生；常用 get 片語

examples.english: I got your message.
Did you get my email?
It's getting cold.
I get tired after a long day.
What time did you get home?
How do I get to the station?
I get what you mean.
I don't get this joke.
Can you get me some water?
examples.chinese: 【去攞】你可唔可以幫我攞啲水？

examples.english: I'll get your coat from the bedroom.
examples.chinese: 【去攞】我去睡房幫你攞件外套。

examples.english: I can't get it to work.
examples.chinese: 【令物件運作／做到某事】我整極都整唔到佢運作。

examples.english: Can you get the printer to work?
examples.chinese: 【令物件運作／做到某事】你可唔可以整到部打印機用得？

examples.english: I need to get some milk on the way home.
Where did you get those shoes?
She got a new job last month.
examples.chinese: 【獲得工作／機會】佢上個月搵到份新工。

examples.english: Did you get a chance to talk to him?
examples.chinese: 【獲得工作／機會】你有冇機會同佢傾？

examples.english: I got a cold after the trip.
He got the flu last winter.
My bag got stolen on the train.
examples.chinese: 【被／遇到某事】我個袋喺火車上俾人偷咗。

examples.english: She got invited to the party.
examples.chinese: 【被／遇到某事】佢獲邀參加個派對。

examples.english: I need to get my phone repaired.
examples.chinese: 【搵人完成某事】我要搵人整電話。

examples.english: We got the windows cleaned yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【搵人完成某事】我哋尋日搵人清潔咗啲窗。

examples.english: Can you get him to call me?
examples.chinese: 【令／說服某人做某事】你可唔可以叫佢打俾我？

examples.english: I got my brother to help with dinner.
examples.chinese: 【令／說服某人做某事】我叫咗阿哥幫手整晚飯。

examples.english: Can you get the phone? I'm cooking.
examples.chinese: 【接聽／應門】你可唔可以聽電話？我煮緊飯。

examples.english: I'll get the door.
I get up at seven on weekdays.
What time did you get up today?
What time will you get back?
We got back from Japan last night.
examples.chinese: 【返嚟／返去】我哋尋晚由日本返嚟。

examples.english: I'll get back to you after lunch.
Can you get back to me by Friday?
examples.chinese: 【稍後回覆】你可唔可以星期五前覆我？

examples.english: Get in the car. It's raining.
I couldn't get in because I had no key.
examples.chinese: 【進入（車／地方）】我冇鎖匙，所以入唔到去。

examples.english: What time does your train get in?
examples.chinese: 【交通工具到達】你班火車幾點到？

examples.english: Our flight got in late.
examples.chinese: 【交通工具到達】我哋班機遲咗到。

examples.english: We need to get out of the building.
examples.chinese: 【離開／出去】我哋要離開呢棟樓。

examples.english: She got out of the taxi near the station.
examples.chinese: 【離開／出去】佢喺車站附近落咗的士。

examples.english: Get on the bus at the next stop.
examples.chinese: 【登上（巴士／火車）】喺下一個站上巴士。

examples.english: We got on the train just in time.
examples.chinese: 【登上（巴士／火車）】我哋啱啱好趕得切上火車。

examples.english: Do you get on with your neighbors?
examples.chinese: 【相處】你同啲鄰居相處得好唔好？

examples.english: I get on well with my sister.
How are you getting on with your project?
I'm getting on well with my English lessons.
examples.chinese: 【進展】我啲英文堂學得幾順利。

examples.english: We get off at the next station.
Where should I get off the bus?
examples.chinese: 【落車】我應該喺邊個站落巴士？

examples.english: What time do you get off work?
I get off work at six today.
It took me a week to get over the flu.
examples.chinese: 【病後康復】我用咗一個星期先流感好返。

examples.english: She is still getting over a bad cold.
examples.chinese: 【病後康復】佢重感冒之後仲未完全好返。

examples.english: We got through all the work before dinner.
examples.chinese: 【完成一批工作】我哋食飯前做晒啲嘢。

examples.english: Can we get through these emails before lunch?
examples.chinese: 【完成一批工作】我哋食晏前覆唔覆得晒呢啲電郵？

examples.english: I couldn't get through to the clinic.
examples.chinese: 【打通電話】我打唔通診所電話。

examples.english: Did you get through to the hotel?
examples.chinese: 【打通電話】你打唔打得通酒店電話？

examples.english: I need to get rid of these old boxes.
examples.chinese: 【擺脫／處理掉】我要掉走呢啲舊箱。

examples.english: How can we get rid of this smell?
examples.chinese: 【擺脫／處理掉】我哋點樣先除到呢陣味？

examples.english: I'm getting used to my new job.
examples.chinese: 【逐漸習慣】我漸漸習慣份新工。

examples.english: It took time to get used to waking up early.
examples.chinese: 【逐漸習慣】我要花啲時間先習慣早起。

examples.english: I get along with everyone at work.
examples.chinese: 【相處（常見美式說法）】我同公司每個人都相處得幾好。

examples.english: Do your children get along with each other?
examples.chinese: 【相處（常見美式說法）】你啲小朋友相處得好唔好？

examples.english: We want to get away for the weekend.
examples.chinese: 【離開去休息／短暫外遊】我哋想週末去第二度休息下。

examples.english: I need to get away from work for a few days.
examples.chinese: 【離開去休息／短暫外遊】我要離開工作休息幾日。

examples.english: Let's get together for lunch next week.
examples.chinese: 【聚埋】我哋下星期一齊食晏啦。

examples.english: The family gets together every Sunday.
examples.chinese: 【聚埋】屋企人每個星期日都會聚埋。

examples.english: It's easy to get around this city by bus.
examples.chinese: 【四圍去／出行】搭巴士喺呢個城市四圍去好方便。

examples.english: How do you get around without a car?
examples.chinese: 【四圍去／出行】你冇車平時點出行？

examples.english: You can't get away with lying to her.
examples.chinese: 【做錯事而冇受罰】你呃佢唔會冇後果。

examples.english: He got away with being late again.
examples.chinese: 【做錯事而冇受罰】佢又遲到，但冇俾人追究。

examples.english: Let's get down to work.
examples.chinese: 【開始認真做】我哋開始認真做嘢啦。

examples.english: I finally got down to writing the email.
examples.chinese: 【開始認真做】我終於開始專心寫嗰封電郵。

examples.english: I haven't got around to reading it yet.
examples.chinese: 【終於抽到時間做】我仲未抽到時間睇。

examples.english: Did you get around to calling the bank?
examples.chinese: 【終於抽到時間做】你最後有冇抽到時間打去銀行？

examples.english: I need to get over my fear of speaking English.
examples.chinese: 【克服困難／恐懼】我要克服講英文嘅恐懼。

examples.english: We got over the problem by working together.
examples.chinese: 【克服困難／恐懼】我哋一齊合作克服咗個問題。

examples.english: Your help got me through a difficult week.
examples.chinese: 【捱過艱難時期】你嘅幫助令我捱過咗艱難嘅一星期。

examples.english: We will get through this together.
examples.chinese: 【捱過艱難時期】我哋會一齊捱過呢段難關。

examples.english: She is still getting over the bad news.
examples.chinese: 【從情緒打擊中恢復】佢仲未從嗰個壞消息嘅打擊中恢復。

examples.english: It took him months to get over the breakup.
examples.chinese: 【從情緒打擊中恢復】佢花咗幾個月先走出分手嘅傷痛。

entries.englishDefinition: To create something, cause a result, earn money, or manage to attend.

examples.english: I made dinner.
I make breakfast for my children every morning.
examples.chinese: 【製作；整】我每日朝早整早餐俾啲小朋友。

examples.english: You make me happy.
That noise makes me nervous.
How much do you make?
examples.pattern: make money; how much do you make?

examples.english: She makes enough to pay the rent.
examples.pattern: make money; how much do you make?

examples.english: We need to make a decision.
Let's make a plan for the weekend.
examples.chinese: 【作出】我哋計劃下週末做咩啦。

examples.english: I can't make it tonight.
Can you make it to the meeting tomorrow?
examples.chinese: 【趕到；出席】你聽日嚟唔嚟到開會？

examples.english: Make sure the door is locked.
Can you make sure everyone knows?
examples.chinese: 【確保】你可唔可以確保每個人都知道？

examples.english: That explanation makes sense.
This question doesn't make sense to me.
examples.chinese: 【講得通】我覺得呢條問題唔合理。

entries.englishDefinition: To travel, do an activity, progress, or change into a state.

examples.english: I'm going home.
We go to the park on Sundays.
Let's go shopping.
Do you want to go swimming later?
examples.chinese: 【去做活動】你遲啲想唔想去游水？

examples.english: How did it go?
examples.chinese: 【事情進行得點】件事進展成點？

examples.english: The interview went well.
examples.chinese: 【事情進行得點】個面試好順利。

examples.english: The milk has gone bad.
His face went red.
And he goes, 'No way.'
Then she goes, 'Are you sure?'
Please go on talking. I'm listening.
He went on working after dinner.
The clock goes tick-tock.
examples.chinese: 【發出某聲音】個鐘滴答滴答咁響。

examples.english: My phone went beep during the meeting.
examples.chinese: 【發出某聲音】我部電話喺開會嗰陣響咗一聲。

entries.englishDefinition: To have information or understanding about something.

examples.english: Do you know the answer?
I know where she lives.
Do you know how to use this machine?
examples.chinese: 【識得點樣做】你識唔識用呢部機？

examples.english: I know how to get to the station.

entries.englishDefinition: To move or carry something from one place to another, or receive something.
chineseMeanings: 拿；帶；花費；接受；乘搭；採取

examples.english: Take an umbrella with you.
Please take these bags upstairs.
examples.chinese: 【拿；帶走】請將呢幾個袋拎上樓。

examples.english: I'll take you home.
Can you take me to the station?
examples.chinese: 【帶某人去】你可唔可以送我去車站？

examples.english: Take this medicine twice a day.
I need to take my medicine after lunch.
It takes about an hour.
How long does it take to walk there?
I'll take this one.
Do you take credit cards?
examples.chinese: 【接受；選擇】你哋收唔收信用卡？

examples.english: Can you take a photo for us?
examples.chinese: 【進行】可唔可以幫我哋影張相？

examples.english: She will take the test next week.
I take the bus to work.
Let's take a taxi home.
We should take a break now.
Can I take a short break?
Please take off your shoes.
He took off his wet jacket.
Our plane takes off at ten.
The flight took off late.

entries.englishDefinition: To notice with your eyes, understand, meet someone, or check something.

examples.english: I can see it.
Did you see the rainbow?
I see what you mean.
Now I see why you were worried.
examples.chinese: 【明白】而家我明點解你會擔心。

examples.english: I'm seeing the doctor tomorrow.
I'm going to see a friend after work.
Let me see if it's available.
Can you see if the shop is open?
examples.chinese: 【睇吓；查明】你可唔可以睇下間舖開咗未？

examples.english: She's seeing someone from work.
examples.chinese: 【同某人交往】佢同公司一個人拍緊拖。

examples.english: Are you seeing anyone at the moment?
examples.chinese: 【同某人交往】你而家有冇拍緊拖？

entries.englishDefinition: To move toward someone, arrive, become something, or be supplied with something.

examples.english: Can you come here?
Please come to my office.
The bus came late.
Your package came this morning.
My dream came true.
I hope your wish comes true.
It comes with a charger.
examples.chinese: 【附有；連同提供】佢跟埋充電器。

examples.english: Does the room come with breakfast?
examples.chinese: 【附有；連同提供】間房包唔包早餐？

examples.english: Can you come up with a better idea?
examples.chinese: 【諗到】你可唔可以諗到個好啲嘅主意？

examples.english: She came up with a plan.

entries.englishDefinition: To use your mind to consider something.

examples.english: Think carefully before you answer.
I need some time to think about it.
I think this is a good idea.
examples.chinese: 【認為】我覺得這是一個好主意。

examples.english: I think we should leave now.
examples.chinese: 【認為】我覺得我哋而家應該走。

entries.englishDefinition: To direct your eyes, appear a certain way, or search for something.

examples.english: Look at this.
Look at the sign above the door.
You look tired.
This soup looks delicious.
I'm looking for my keys.
Are you looking for someone?
I'll look into it.
We need to look into the problem.
examples.chinese: 【查看；研究】我哋要查清楚個問題。

examples.english: Can you look after my cat?
examples.chinese: 【照顧】你可唔可以幫我照顧隻貓？

examples.english: She looks after her younger brother.
I look forward to seeing you.
We're looking forward to the holiday.

entries.englishDefinition: To wish to have or do something.

examples.english: I want to go home now.
Do you want some water?

entries.englishDefinition: To hand something to someone or provide something.

examples.english: Please give me a glass of water.
She gave her friend a birthday present.
examples.chinese: 【給予】她送了一份生日禮物給朋友。

examples.english: Don't give up learning English.
She gave up smoking.

entries.englishDefinition: To do something with a tool, object, or method for a purpose.

examples.english: Can I use your charger?
examples.chinese: 【使用】我可以用你的充電器嗎？

examples.english: We use this room for meetings.
I used to live near the sea.
examples.chinese: 【過去慣常／曾經】我以前住喺海邊。

examples.english: She used to walk to school.
examples.chinese: 【過去慣常／曾經】佢以前行路返學。

examples.english: I'm used to working at night.
examples.chinese: 【已經習慣】我習慣咗夜晚做嘢。

examples.english: Are you used to the weather here?
examples.chinese: 【已經習慣】你習唔習慣呢度嘅天氣？

entries.englishDefinition: To discover or locate someone or something.

examples.english: I cannot find my keys.
She found a good restaurant near the station.
examples.chinese: 【找到】她在車站附近找到一間不錯的餐廳。

entries.englishDefinition: To give someone information by speaking or writing.

examples.english: Please tell me your name.
Can you tell me the time?
examples.chinese: 【告訴】你可唔可以話我知而家幾點？

examples.english: He told me to wait here.
examples.chinese: 【叫某人做某事】佢叫我喺度等。

examples.english: The teacher told us to read the first page.
examples.chinese: 【叫某人做某事】老師叫我哋睇第一頁。

entries.englishDefinition: To say something in order to get information or help.

examples.english: Can I ask you a question?
May I ask where you bought this?
examples.chinese: 【問】我可唔可以問下你喺邊度買呢個？

examples.english: She asked for some help.
He asked for a glass of water.

entries.englishDefinition: To do a job, function correctly, or produce the intended result.

examples.english: I work from home.
She works in a hospital.
My phone isn't working.
Does this lift work?
That might work.
Your idea worked really well.
I work out three times a week.
Do you work out at home or at a gym?
examples.chinese: 【鍛鍊】你喺屋企定健身室做運動？

examples.english: We need to work out a plan.
examples.chinese: 【解決／諗清楚】我哋要諗出一個計劃。

examples.english: Did you work out the answer?
examples.chinese: 【解決／諗清楚】你諗唔諗到答案？

entries.englishDefinition: To give the impression of being something.

examples.english: You seem tired today.
It seems to work now.

entries.englishDefinition: To experience an emotion or physical condition.

examples.english: I feel tired after work.
She felt happy when she saw her friends.
examples.chinese: 【感到】她見到朋友時感到很開心。

examples.english: Feel this blanket. It's so soft.
examples.chinese: 【摸／感覺質地】摸下張氈，好軟熟。

examples.english: Can you feel the water to see if it's warm?
examples.chinese: 【摸／感覺質地】你可唔可以摸下啲水夠唔夠暖？

entries.englishDefinition: To make an effort to do something.

examples.english: Try to finish the work today.
examples.chinese: 【努力嘗試】嘗試今天完成工作。

examples.english: I'll try to call you before lunch.
examples.chinese: 【努力嘗試】我會盡量食晏前打俾你。

examples.english: I tried the new restaurant yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【試用／試食】我昨天試了那間新餐廳。

examples.english: Would you like to try this soup?
examples.chinese: 【試用／試食】你想唔想試下呢個湯？

entries.englishDefinition: To go away, not take something with you, or let something stay in a state.

examples.english: I have to leave now.
What time does your train leave?
Leave it here.
I left my phone at home.
Leave the door open.
Please leave the window closed.
Leave it to me.
I left the keys with my neighbor.
examples.chinese: 【交畀】我將啲鎖匙交咗俾鄰居。

entries.englishDefinition: To telephone, name, or shout for someone; also used in fixed expressions.

examples.english: Call me later.
Can I call you after dinner?
examples.chinese: 【打電話】我可唔可以食完飯打俾你？

examples.english: They call him Ed.
What do you call this in English?
She called my name.
He called for help from the window.
Let's call it a day.
examples.chinese: 【今日做到呢度；收工】今日做到呢度啦。

examples.english: We've done enough, so let's call it a day.
examples.chinese: 【今日做到呢度；收工】我哋做得夠多喇，今日做到呢度啦。

entries.englishDefinition: To continue having or doing something, or maintain a state.

examples.english: Keep the receipt.
You can keep the extra copy.
examples.chinese: 【保留；保存】多出嚟嗰份你可以留低。

examples.english: Keep going.
She kept asking the same question.
Keep quiet.
Try to keep calm.
This keeps me awake.
examples.chinese: 【令某人保持某狀態】呢樣嘢令我瞓唔著。

examples.english: This coat will keep you warm.
examples.chinese: 【令某人保持某狀態】呢件外套可以幫你保暖。

entries.englishDefinition: To allow someone to do something.

examples.english: Let me help you.
My parents let me stay out late.
examples.chinese: 【容許；讓】我父母俾我夜啲先返屋企。

entries.englishDefinition: To place something somewhere or express an idea.

examples.english: Put it on the table.
Where did you put my keys?
How should I put it?
Let me put it another way.
Don't put yourself under pressure.
examples.chinese: 【使處於某狀態】唔好畀自己太大壓力。

examples.english: The news put her in a good mood.
examples.chinese: 【使處於某狀態】個消息令佢心情好咗。

examples.english: We put off the meeting until Friday.
examples.chinese: 【延遲】我哋將個會延期到星期五。

examples.english: Don't put off calling the doctor.
I can't put up with this noise.
How do you put up with waiting so long?

entries.englishDefinition: To have a meaning, intend something, or involve a result.

examples.english: What does this mean?
What does this sign mean?
I didn't mean to hurt you.
I meant to call you yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【打算】我本來打算尋日打俾你。

examples.english: It means waiting another hour.
Moving here means paying more rent.
examples.chinese: 【意味住】搬嚟呢度意味住要交多啲租。

entries.englishDefinition: To start to be something different.

examples.english: The weather became colder at night.
She wants to become a teacher.

entries.englishDefinition: To let someone see something, demonstrate it, or guide someone.

examples.english: Show me the photo.
Can you show me your ticket?
examples.chinese: 【展示】你可唔可以俾張飛我睇？

examples.english: Show me how to do it.
She showed me how to make bread.
The results show a change.
The map shows where the station is.
I'll show you around.
Can someone show me to my room?
examples.chinese: 【帶路】可唔可以有人帶我去間房？

entries.englishDefinition: To notice a sound with your ears.

examples.english: Can you hear the music?
I heard someone knock on the door.
Did you hear about the new restaurant?
examples.chinese: 【聽聞消息】你有冇聽講嗰間新餐廳？

examples.english: I heard about the delay this morning.
examples.chinese: 【聽聞消息】我今朝聽講咗延誤件事。

entries.englishDefinition: To take part in games, perform music, play media, or act a role.

examples.english: Do you play basketball?
The children are playing a board game.
examples.chinese: 【玩；打某運動】啲小朋友玩緊棋盤遊戲。

examples.english: She plays the piano.
Can you play the guitar?
Play it again.
Could you play that song again?
examples.chinese: 【播放】可唔可以再播一次首歌？

examples.english: He plays the doctor.
She plays the mother in the film.

entries.englishDefinition: To move quickly on foot, operate, manage something, or flow.

examples.english: I run every morning.
I had to run to catch the bus.
The app is running.
Leave the fan running for a while.
She runs a small company.
examples.chinese: 【經營；管理】佢經營一間細公司。

examples.english: Who runs this restaurant?
examples.chinese: 【經營；管理】邊個經營呢間餐廳？

examples.english: Water was running down the wall.
Tears ran down her face.
examples.chinese: 【流動】眼淚沿住佢塊面流落嚟。

examples.english: The train runs every ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 【行駛；延續】班火車每十分鐘一班。

examples.english: Does this bus run on Sundays?
examples.chinese: 【行駛；延續】呢班巴士星期日有冇車？

entries.englishDefinition: To change position or go from one place to another.

examples.english: Please move your bag off the chair.
examples.chinese: 【移動】請把你的袋從椅子上移開。

examples.english: Could you move your chair a little?
examples.chinese: 【移動】你可唔可以移開張櫈少少？

examples.english: We moved to a new apartment last year.
examples.chinese: 【搬屋】我們去年搬到一個新單位。

examples.english: We are moving to a bigger flat.
examples.chinese: 【搬屋】我哋會搬去個大啲嘅單位。

entries.englishDefinition: To have your home in a particular place or be alive.

examples.english: I live near the station.
Many people live in this building.
My grandfather lived to be ninety.
examples.chinese: 【生存／活著】我阿爺活到九十歲。

examples.english: These plants cannot live without water.
examples.chinese: 【生存／活著】呢啲植物冇水就生存唔到。

entries.englishDefinition: To think that something is true.

examples.english: I believe what you said.
She believes she can pass the test.
examples.chinese: 【相信】她相信自己可以通過測驗。

entries.englishDefinition: To carry something toward a person or place, or cause a result.

examples.english: Bring your ID.
Can you bring some water for the trip?
examples.chinese: 【帶嚟】你可唔可以帶啲水去旅行？

examples.english: That brings back memories.
examples.chinese: 【勾起回憶】嗰樣令我諗返起以前。

examples.english: This song brings back memories of school.
examples.chinese: 【勾起回憶】呢首歌勾起我返學嗰陣嘅回憶。

entries.englishDefinition: To take place or occur.

examples.english: What happened yesterday?
What will happen if we miss the train?
examples.chinese: 【發生】如果我哋趕唔切班火車會點？

examples.english: I happen to know her.
Do you happen to have a pen?
examples.chinese: 【碰巧】你有冇啱啱好帶咗支筆？

entries.englishDefinition: To make letters, words, or sentences using a pen, keyboard, or other tool.

examples.english: Write your name at the top of the page.
examples.chinese: 【書寫】在頁面頂部寫上你的名字。

examples.english: She wrote an email to her teacher.
examples.chinese: 【書寫】她寫了一封電郵給老師。

entries.englishDefinition: To give someone something they need.

examples.english: Does the hotel provide breakfast?
They provide us with clean towels.
examples.chinese: 【提供】佢哋提供乾淨毛巾俾我哋。

entries.englishDefinition: To rest your body on a chair or other surface.

examples.english: Please sit beside me.
We sat outside the cafe.

entries.englishDefinition: To be upright on your feet.

examples.english: Please stand behind the yellow line.
He stood near the door.

entries.englishDefinition: To be unable to find or keep something.

examples.english: Do not lose your ticket.
I lost my wallet on the bus.
examples.chinese: 【失去】我在巴士上丟失了銀包。

entries.englishDefinition: To give money in exchange for something.

examples.english: Can I pay by credit card?
examples.chinese: 【付款】我可以用信用卡付款嗎？

examples.english: He paid the bill after dinner.
Please pay attention to the signs.
I wasn't paying attention to the time.

entries.englishDefinition: To come together with someone.

examples.english: Let's meet at the station at six.
I met my old teacher yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【見面】我昨天遇到以前的老師。

entries.englishDefinition: To have something as part of a whole.

examples.english: The price includes breakfast.
Please include your phone number on the form.
examples.chinese: 【包括】請在表格上填上你的電話號碼。

entries.englishDefinition: To keep doing something without stopping.

examples.english: Please continue reading.
The rain continued all night.

entries.englishDefinition: To place, adjust, or establish something; also a group of related things or being ready.
chineseMeanings: 放置；設定；制定；準備好；一套

examples.english: Set it on the table.
She set the plates on the table.
Set an alarm for seven.
Can you set the temperature to twenty degrees?
examples.chinese: 【設定】你可唔可以將溫度較到二十度？

examples.english: Set a clear goal.
We need to set a date for the meeting.
examples.chinese: 【制定；設立】我哋要定開會日期。

examples.english: We're all set.
Are you all set for your trip?
I bought a set of cups.
This set of keys belongs to my sister.

entries.englishDefinition: To gain knowledge or skill through study or experience.

examples.english: I am learning English online.
Children learn quickly through practice.
examples.chinese: 【學習】小朋友透過練習學得很快。

entries.englishDefinition: To make or become different.

examples.english: I want to change my password.
The weather can change quickly.
Where can I change some dollars?
examples.chinese: 【找換錢】我可以喺邊度兌換啲美元？

examples.english: Can you change a twenty-dollar note?
examples.chinese: 【找換錢】你可唔可以幫我唱開張廿蚊紙？

examples.english: I need to change into dry clothes.
She changed into a warm jacket.

entries.englishDefinition: To guide someone or cause a particular result.

examples.english: This road will lead you to the station.
examples.chinese: 【帶領；通往；導致】沿住呢條路行就會到車站。

examples.english: Can you lead the meeting today?
examples.chinese: 【帶領；通往；導致】你今日可唔可以主持個會？

examples.english: Lack of sleep can lead to mistakes.
The meeting led to a new plan.
examples.chinese: 【導致】個會促成咗一個新計劃。

entries.englishDefinition: To know what something means or why something happens.

examples.english: I do not understand this question.
I understand how you feel.

entries.englishDefinition: To look at something for a period of time.

examples.english: We watched a movie last night.
examples.chinese: 【觀看】我們昨晚看了一套電影。

examples.english: Watch the road when you cross.

entries.englishDefinition: To go after someone or do what instructions say.

examples.english: Follow me to the meeting room.
The dog followed me home.
Please follow the instructions carefully.
You must follow the safety rules.

entries.englishDefinition: To finish moving or doing something.

examples.english: The bus stopped outside the station.
Please stop talking for a moment.
We stopped to buy some water.
examples.chinese: 【停低去做另一件事】我哋停低買啲水。

examples.english: She stopped to answer the phone.
examples.chinese: 【停低去做另一件事】佢停低手上嘅嘢去聽電話。

entries.englishDefinition: To make something new.

examples.english: She created a new folder on her computer.
examples.chinese: 【創造】她在電腦建立了一個新資料夾。

examples.english: The artist created a beautiful picture.
examples.chinese: 【創造】藝術家創作了一幅漂亮的畫。

entries.englishDefinition: To say words or talk to someone.

examples.english: Can you speak more slowly?
She speaks English at work.

entries.englishDefinition: To look at and understand written words.

examples.english: I read the news every morning.
Please read the question carefully.

entries.englishDefinition: To give permission for someone to do something.

examples.english: The library does not allow food inside.
examples.chinese: 【允許；准許】圖書館不允許在裡面進食。

examples.english: This app allows users to save new vocabulary.
examples.chinese: 【允許；准許】這個應用程式允許用戶儲存新詞彙。

entries.englishDefinition: To put something together with something else.

examples.english: Please add some sugar to my tea.
examples.chinese: 【加入】請在我的茶裏加一點糖。

examples.english: Add your name to the list.
examples.chinese: 【加入】把你的名字加到名單上。

entries.englishDefinition: To use money or time for something.

examples.english: I spend about an hour reading every day.
examples.chinese: 【花費】我每天大約花一小時閱讀。

examples.english: She spent too much money on clothes.
examples.chinese: 【花費】她在衣服上花了太多錢。

entries.englishDefinition: To become larger, older, or more developed.

examples.english: Children grow quickly.
The baby has grown a lot.
We grow tomatoes in the garden.
Can we grow herbs on the balcony?
examples.chinese: 【種植】我哋可唔可以喺露台種香草？

examples.english: It grew dark while we were walking.
examples.chinese: 【漸漸變得】我哋行緊嗰陣，天色漸漸暗咗。

examples.english: He grew more confident with practice.
examples.chinese: 【漸漸變得】佢練習之後漸漸有信心。

entries.englishDefinition: To move something so that it is no longer closed.

examples.english: Please open the window.
Can you open this jar for me?
examples.chinese: 【打開】你可唔可以幫我開呢個樽？

examples.english: The bank opens at nine.
What time does the restaurant open?

entries.englishDefinition: To move forward on foot at a normal speed.

examples.english: I walk to the station every morning.
examples.chinese: 【步行】我每天早上步行去車站。

examples.english: Let's go for a walk after dinner.

entries.englishDefinition: To be the best or first in a game, competition, or contest.

examples.english: Our team won the game yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【勝出】我們的隊伍昨天贏了比賽。

examples.english: She hopes to win the competition.

entries.englishDefinition: To ask if someone wants something, or make something available.

examples.english: Can I offer you a drink?
examples.chinese: 【主動提供；提議】你想唔想飲啲嘢？

examples.english: She offered to help me.
examples.chinese: 【主動提供；提議】佢主動話幫我。

entries.englishDefinition: To keep or bring something back into your mind.

examples.english: Remember to lock the door.
Please remember to bring your ticket.
examples.chinese: 【記住要做某事】請記得帶張飛。

examples.english: I remember meeting her last year.
examples.chinese: 【記得曾經做過】我記得上年見過佢。

examples.english: Do you remember leaving your bag here?
examples.chinese: 【記得曾經做過】你記唔記得曾經將個袋放喺呢度？

entries.englishDefinition: To like someone or something very much.

examples.english: I love spending time with my family.
She loves chocolate cake.

entries.englishDefinition: To think carefully about something before deciding.

examples.english: We should consider taking the train.
Please consider my idea.

entries.englishDefinition: To become visible or seem to be a certain way.

examples.english: A message appeared on the screen.
examples.chinese: 【出現】螢幕上出現了一個訊息。

examples.english: His name appeared on the screen.
She appeared tired after work.
There appears to be a mistake.

entries.englishDefinition: To get something by paying money for it.

examples.english: I need to buy some milk.
She bought a new pair of shoes.

entries.englishDefinition: To stay until someone comes or something happens.

examples.english: Please wait here for five minutes.
We waited for the bus in the rain.

entries.englishDefinition: To provide food, drinks, or a service to someone.

examples.english: This restaurant serves breakfast all day.
examples.chinese: 【供應】這間餐廳全日供應早餐。

examples.english: The waiter served us quickly.

entries.englishDefinition: To cause a message, item, or person to go to another place.

examples.english: Please send me the photo.
I sent the email this morning.

entries.englishDefinition: To think something is likely to happen.

examples.english: I expect to get home by six.
examples.chinese: 【預期；估計】我估六點前會返到屋企。

examples.english: We expect the bus to arrive soon.
examples.chinese: 【預期；估計】我哋估架巴士就快到。

entries.englishDefinition: To make something by putting parts together.

examples.english: They plan to build a new school.
examples.chinese: 【建造】他們計劃興建一間新學校。

examples.english: The children built a house with blocks.
examples.chinese: 【建造】小朋友用積木砌了一間屋。

entries.englishDefinition: To remain in a place or condition.

examples.english: We stayed at a small hotel.
Please stay here until I come back.
examples.chinese: 【逗留】請留在這裏直到我回來。

examples.english: Please stay calm.
How do you stay healthy?
examples.chinese: 【保持某狀態】你點樣保持健康？

entries.englishDefinition: To move downward, decrease, or enter a particular state.

examples.english: I almost fell.
The cup fell off the table.
examples.chinese: 【跌；掉落】隻杯由枱面跌咗落嚟。

examples.english: Prices have fallen.
The temperature fell overnight.
I fell asleep.
I fell asleep on the train.
My birthday falls on a Monday.
examples.chinese: 【日期適逢某日】我生日嗰日係星期一。

examples.english: The holiday falls on a Friday this year.
examples.chinese: 【日期適逢某日】今年個假期適逢星期五。

examples.english: She fell ill during the trip.
He fell ill just before the holiday.

entries.englishDefinition: To divide something using a knife, scissors, or another sharp tool.

examples.english: Cut the apple into four pieces.
Be careful when you cut the paper.

entries.englishDefinition: To arrive at a place, get in contact, or stretch to touch something.

examples.english: We should reach the hotel by six.
examples.chinese: 【到達】我哋應該六點前到酒店。

examples.english: We reached the city before dark.
examples.chinese: 【到達】我哋天黑前到咗個城市。

examples.english: You can reach me by phone.
I tried to reach you all morning.
examples.chinese: 【聯絡到】我成個朝早都嘗試聯絡你。

examples.english: I cannot reach the top shelf.
examples.chinese: 【伸手夠到】我夠唔到最上面個架。

examples.english: Can you reach that cup for me?
examples.chinese: 【伸手夠到】你可唔可以幫我拎嗰隻杯？

entries.englishDefinition: To damage something, interrupt it, share news, or take a short rest.
chineseMeanings: 打破；弄壞；中斷；休息；違反

examples.english: I broke my phone.
Be careful not to break the cup.
examples.chinese: 【打爛；整壞】小心唔好打爛隻杯。

examples.english: Don't break the rules.
I want to break this bad habit.
examples.chinese: 【中斷；打破】我想改掉呢個壞習慣。

examples.english: Let's take a break.
You should take a break from the screen.
examples.chinese: 【休息】你應該停低休息下，唔好一直望住個畫面。

examples.english: Who broke the news to him?
examples.chinese: 【公布；爆出】邊個話咗個消息畀佢知？

examples.english: How should we break the news to her?
examples.chinese: 【公布；爆出】我哋應該點樣將消息話俾佢知？

entries.englishDefinition: To stay in a place or continue in a state.

examples.english: Please remain seated until we stop.
examples.chinese: 【留下；保持】請坐定，等我哋停咗先。

examples.english: The shop will remain closed tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 【留下；保持】間舖聽日會繼續休息。

entries.englishDefinition: To put forward an idea for someone to consider.

examples.english: I suggest taking the bus.
Can you suggest a good restaurant?
examples.chinese: 【建議】你可唔可以介紹間好餐廳？

entries.englishDefinition: To move something higher or increase it.

examples.english: Raise your hand if you need help.
examples.chinese: 【舉起；提高】有需要幫手就舉手。

examples.english: They plan to raise the price next month.
examples.chinese: 【舉起；提高】佢哋打算下個月加價。

entries.englishDefinition: To go past, hand something to someone, succeed in a test, or describe time going by.
chineseMeanings: 通過；經過；傳遞；考試合格

examples.english: I pass the station every day.
You will pass a supermarket on your left.
examples.chinese: 【經過】你會經過左邊一間超級市場。

examples.english: Pass me the salt.
Could you pass her the menu?
examples.chinese: 【遞俾】你可唔可以將餐牌遞俾佢？

examples.english: I passed the exam.
Did you pass your driving test?
Time passes quickly.
An hour passed before the bus came.
examples.chinese: 【時間過去】等咗一個鐘架巴士先到。

entries.englishDefinition: To give something to someone in exchange for money.

examples.english: This shop sells fresh bread.
He sold his old phone online.

entries.englishDefinition: To choose what you are going to do after thinking about it.

examples.english: We need to decide where to eat.
examples.chinese: 【決定】我們需要決定去哪裏吃飯。

examples.english: She decided to take the bus.

entries.englishDefinition: To use force to move something toward you.

examples.english: Pull the door to open it.
She pulled the suitcase behind her.

entries.englishDefinition: To go or come back, or give something back.

examples.english: I will return home before ten.
When will you return from your trip?
Please return the book next week.
Can I return this shirt if it doesn't fit?
examples.chinese: 【歸還】如果件衫唔啱身，我可唔可以退貨？

entries.englishDefinition: To make something clear by giving details or reasons.

examples.english: Can you explain this question to me?
examples.chinese: 【解釋】你可以向我解釋這條問題嗎？

examples.english: The teacher explained the rule clearly.
examples.chinese: 【解釋】老師清楚解釋了這條規則。

entries.englishDefinition: To want something to happen and think it may happen.

examples.english: I hope you feel better soon.
We hope to visit Japan next year.

entries.englishDefinition: To grow or gradually make something better or more complete.

examples.english: I want to develop better study habits.
examples.chinese: 【發展；培養；開發】我想培養更好嘅學習習慣。

examples.english: They develop apps for small shops.
examples.chinese: 【發展；培養；開發】佢哋為小店開發應用程式。

entries.englishDefinition: To hold something and take it from one place to another.

examples.english: Can you carry this bag for me?
examples.chinese: 【攜帶】你可以幫我拿這個袋嗎？

examples.english: She carries a bottle of water every day.

entries.englishDefinition: To control and operate a car or other vehicle.

examples.english: She drives to work every morning.
Do not use your phone while driving.

entries.englishDefinition: To put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow it.

examples.english: We usually eat dinner at seven.
Eat some fruit every day.

entries.englishDefinition: To decide which person or thing you want.

examples.english: Choose one answer from the list.
She chose the blue dress.

entries.englishDefinition: To have clothes, shoes, glasses, or other items on your body.

examples.english: She wears glasses when she reads.
Wear a jacket because it is cold outside.

entries.englishDefinition: To choose, lift something, or collect someone.

examples.english: Pick one.
You can pick any seat you like.
examples.chinese: 【揀】你可以揀任何一個鍾意嘅位。

examples.english: Pick it up.
Please pick up the toys from the floor.
I'll pick you up at eight.
Can you pick me up from the station?
examples.chinese: 【接人】你可唔可以嚟車站接我？

entries.englishDefinition: To let something fall, decrease, stop something, or take someone somewhere.

examples.english: Don't drop it.
I dropped my phone on the floor.
examples.chinese: 【跌落；掉低】我唔小心跌咗部電話落地。

examples.english: The price dropped.
The temperature drops after sunset.
I'll drop you off.
Could you drop me off at the corner?
examples.chinese: 【順路送】你可唔可以喺街角放低我？

examples.english: Let's drop it.
She decided to drop the subject.
examples.chinese: 【停止；放棄】佢決定唔再講呢個話題。

entries.englishDefinition: To become part of a group or take part in an activity.

examples.english: Would you like to join our team?
examples.chinese: 【加入】你想加入我們的隊伍嗎？

examples.english: He joined the company last month.
examples.chinese: 【加入】他上個月加入了這間公司。

entries.englishDefinition: To keep something for future use or prevent it from being lost.

examples.english: Save the file before you close the program.
examples.chinese: 【儲存】關閉程式前先儲存檔案。

examples.english: Did you save your changes?
I am saving money for a holiday.
We save a little money every month.
examples.chinese: 【儲錢】我哋每個月都儲少少錢。

entries.englishDefinition: To decide in advance what you are going to do.

examples.english: We plan to travel next month.
examples.chinese: 【計劃（動詞）】我們計劃下個月旅行。

examples.english: Do you plan to stay here long?
examples.chinese: 【計劃（動詞）】你打唔打算喺度住好耐？

examples.english: Let's make a plan for the weekend.
examples.chinese: 【計劃（名詞）】我們為週末訂一個計劃吧。

examples.english: What is your plan for tomorrow?

entries.englishDefinition: To look at something carefully to make sure it is correct or safe.

examples.english: Check your answers before you submit the test.
I checked the train time online.
examples.chinese: 【檢查】我在網上查了火車時間。

entries.englishDefinition: To make it easier for someone to do something.

examples.english: Can you help me carry this box?
examples.chinese: 【幫助（動詞）】你可以幫我搬這個箱嗎？

examples.english: She helped me find my keys.
examples.chinese: 【幫助（動詞）】佢幫我搵到啲鎖匙。

examples.english: Thank you for your help.
I need some help with this form.
examples.chinese: 【幫助（名詞）】呢份表我要搵人幫手填。

entries.englishDefinition: To speak with someone in a conversation.

examples.english: Can we talk after class?
examples.chinese: 【談話】我們可以下課後談談嗎？

examples.english: They talked about their holiday plans.

entries.englishDefinition: To move around a point or change direction.

examples.english: Turn the handle.
Turn the key to unlock the door.
Turn left here.
Turn right after the bridge.
The sky turned dark.
The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
Turn off the light.
Can you turn on the fan?
examples.chinese: 【開／關電器】你可唔可以開風扇？

examples.english: It's your turn.
Please wait for your turn.

entries.englishDefinition: To begin doing or happening.

examples.english: The lesson starts at eight thirty.
Press this button to start the machine.

entries.englishDefinition: To finish or stop.

examples.english: The movie ends at ten.
We ended the meeting early.

entries.englishDefinition: To require something because it is necessary.

examples.english: I need more time to finish this.
examples.chinese: 【需要】我需要更多時間完成這件事。

examples.english: Do you need any help?

entries.englishDefinition: To enjoy something; also used to compare similar things.

examples.english: I like cooking at home.
Do you like watching movies?
You look like your brother.
This tastes like chicken.

entries.englishDefinition: To dislike someone or something very much.

examples.english: I hate waiting in long lines.
I hate it when people are late.

entries.englishDefinition: To object to something, pay attention, or refer to a person's thoughts.

examples.english: Do you mind waiting?
Would you mind opening the window?
Mind the step.
Mind your head when you go through the door.
examples.chinese: 【留意；小心】行過度門嗰陣小心撞頭。

examples.english: What's on your mind?
I can't get that song out of my mind.
examples.chinese: 【頭腦；想法】嗰首歌一直喺我腦海入面。

entries.englishDefinition: To be important; also a subject or situation to deal with.

examples.english: It doesn't matter.
Your opinion matters to me.
examples.chinese: 【要緊；有影響】你嘅意見對我好重要。

examples.english: It's a private matter.
We can discuss the matter tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 【事情；問題】我哋可以聽日再傾呢件事。

entries.englishDefinition: To give an answer when you are not sure.

examples.english: Can you guess the answer?
I guessed his age correctly.

entries.englishDefinition: To form a picture or idea in your mind.

examples.english: Imagine living near the sea.
I cannot imagine life without my phone.
examples.chinese: 【想像】我想像唔到冇電話嘅生活。

entries.englishDefinition: To fail to remember something.

examples.english: Do not forget your umbrella.
I forgot to send the email yesterday.

entries.englishDefinition: To grip, keep in a position, organize an event, or contain something.

examples.english: Hold my hand.
Can you hold my bag for a moment?
examples.chinese: 【揸住；握住】你可唔可以幫我拎住個袋一陣？

examples.english: Hold the door open.
Hold your head still for a moment.
We held a meeting.
They will hold a party on Saturday.
The room holds 20 people.
This bottle holds one liter of water.

entries.englishDefinition: To repair something that is broken or not working.

examples.english: Can you fix my computer?
examples.chinese: 【修理】你可以修理我的電腦嗎？

examples.english: He fixed the broken chair.

entries.englishDefinition: To prepare food by heating it.

examples.english: I usually cook dinner at home.
He is learning to cook simple meals.
examples.chinese: 【煮食】他正在學習煮簡單的飯菜。

entries.englishDefinition: To remove dirt from something.

examples.english: I clean my room every Saturday.
examples.chinese: 【清潔】我每個星期六清潔房間。

examples.english: Can you clean the table after lunch?
examples.chinese: 【清潔】你食完晏可唔可以抹枱？

examples.english: Please keep the kitchen clean.
Are these cups clean?

entries.englishDefinition: To clean something with water and usually soap.

examples.english: Wash your hands before eating.
I washed the dishes after dinner.

entries.englishDefinition: To go from one place to another, especially over a long distance.

examples.english: I like to travel by train.
She traveled to Japan last year.

entries.englishDefinition: To go to see a person or place for a short time.

examples.english: We visited our grandparents last weekend.
examples.chinese: 【探訪】我們上週末探望了祖父母。

examples.english: I want to visit London one day.

entries.englishDefinition: To ask for food, goods, or services, or tell someone what to do.

examples.english: We ordered two pizzas for dinner.
examples.chinese: 【落單】我們晚飯訂了兩個薄餅。

examples.english: I'd like to order a bowl of soup.
You can order the book online.
examples.chinese: 【訂購】你可以在網上訂購這本書。

examples.english: I ordered a new charger yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【訂購】我尋日訂咗個新充電器。

entries.englishDefinition: To say or write something in reply to a question.

examples.english: Please answer my question.
Can you answer this question?
He answered the phone quickly.
Please answer the door.

entries.englishDefinition: To have the same opinion as someone or accept a suggestion.

examples.english: I agree with your idea.
They agreed to meet at six.

entries.englishDefinition: To have a different opinion.

examples.english: I disagree with that idea.
We disagree about the best way to do it.
examples.chinese: 【不同意】我哋對最佳做法有唔同意見。

entries.englishDefinition: To use, have, or give something together with others.

examples.english: Can we share this table?
examples.chinese: 【分享】我們可以共用這張桌嗎？

examples.english: She shared the photo with her friends.

entries.englishDefinition: To take and use something that belongs to someone else and return it later.

examples.english: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.chinese: 【借入；借用】我可以借你的筆用一分鐘嗎？

examples.english: She borrowed a book from the library.
examples.chinese: 【借入；借用】她從圖書館借了一本書。

entries.englishDefinition: To give something to someone for a short time and expect it back.

examples.english: Can you lend me your pen?
She lent her brother some money.

entries.englishDefinition: To fail to catch, see, or attend something, or feel sad because someone is absent.

examples.english: I missed the bus this morning.
examples.chinese: 【錯過】我今天早上錯過了巴士。

examples.english: If we leave late, we'll miss the film.
examples.chinese: 【錯過】如果我哋遲出門口，就睇唔切套戲。

examples.english: I miss my family.
Do you miss your old friends?
examples.chinese: 【掛住】你掛唔掛住以前啲朋友？

entries.englishDefinition: To capture something, get a bus or train, become ill, or hear what someone says.

examples.english: Catch the ball.
Can you catch this ball?
examples.chinese: 【接住；捉住】你接唔接到呢個波？

examples.english: I need to catch the train.
We can catch the next bus.
examples.chinese: 【趕／乘搭】我哋可以搭下一班巴士。

examples.english: I caught a cold.
He caught the flu last week.
Sorry, I didn't catch that.
examples.chinese: 【聽清楚；明白】唔好意思，我聽唔清楚。

examples.english: Did you catch her name?
examples.chinese: 【聽清楚；明白】你有冇聽清楚佢個名？

entries.englishDefinition: To send something through the air using your hand or arm.

examples.english: Throw the ball to me.
Do not throw rubbish on the ground.

entries.englishDefinition: To use force to move something away from you.

examples.english: Push the door to open it.
He pushed the shopping cart slowly.

entries.englishDefinition: To put your hand or another part of your body on something.

examples.english: Do not touch the hot pan.
The screen responds when you touch it.
examples.chinese: 【觸摸】你觸碰螢幕時它會有反應。

entries.englishDefinition: To put something over another thing or include an area or subject.

examples.english: Cover the food before putting it in the fridge.
examples.chinese: 【覆蓋】把食物蓋好再放進雪櫃。

examples.english: Snow covered the mountain.

entries.englishDefinition: To shut something or make it stop being open.

examples.english: Please close the door.
Please close the window before you leave.
The shop closes at ten.
What time does the bank close?

entries.englishDefinition: To go or come into a place.

examples.english: Please knock before you enter the room.
You can enter the building through that door.
examples.chinese: 【進入】你可以由嗰度門入去棟樓。

examples.english: Enter your password to continue.
Please enter your email address here.
examples.chinese: 【輸入】請喺呢度輸入你嘅電郵地址。

entries.englishDefinition: To complete something or reach the end of it.

examples.english: Finish your homework before dinner.
I finished reading the book last night.

entries.englishDefinition: To get pleasure from something.

examples.english: I enjoy listening to music.
We enjoyed our trip very much.
examples.chinese: 【享受】我們非常享受這次旅行。

entries.englishDefinition: To like one thing more than another.

examples.english: I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.chinese: 【比較鍾意；寧願】比起咖啡，我比較鍾意茶。

examples.english: I prefer to stay home tonight.
examples.chinese: 【比較鍾意；寧願】我今晚寧願留喺屋企。

entries.englishDefinition: To rest and become less worried or tense.

examples.english: I like to relax after work.
Sit down and relax for a while.

entries.englishDefinition: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind inactive.

examples.english: I usually sleep for seven hours.
The baby is sleeping now.

entries.englishDefinition: To stop sleeping or make someone stop sleeping.

examples.english: I usually wake up at seven.
Please do not wake the baby.

entries.englishDefinition: To learn about a subject by reading, attending classes, or practicing.

examples.english: I study English every evening.
She is studying for an exam.

entries.englishDefinition: To help someone learn something.

examples.english: She teaches English at a primary school.
Can you teach me how to use this app?
examples.chinese: 【教導】你可以教我怎樣用這個應用程式嗎？

entries.englishDefinition: To do something repeatedly to improve your skill.

examples.english: Practice speaking English every day.
She practices the piano after school.

entries.englishDefinition: To make or become better.

examples.english: Practice will improve your English.
The weather improved in the afternoon.

entries.englishDefinition: To get something ready for use or for an event.

examples.english: I need to prepare for tomorrow's meeting.
examples.chinese: 【準備】我需要為明天的會議作準備。

examples.english: She prepared dinner for the family.

entries.englishDefinition: To reach a place at the end of a journey.

examples.english: Please arrive at the station before nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 【到達；抵達】請在九點前到達車站。

examples.english: The package arrived safely this morning.
examples.chinese: 【到達；抵達】包裹今天早上安全送達。

entries.englishDefinition: The continuous measure of minutes, hours, days, and years.

examples.english: What time does the meeting start?
I do not have enough time today.

entries.englishDefinition: A human being.

examples.english: Only one person can enter at a time.
She is a very kind person.

entries.englishDefinition: More than one person.

examples.english: There are five people in our team.
Many people take the bus to work.

entries.englishDefinition: A period of twenty-four hours, or the time when it is light.

examples.english: I had a busy day at work.
I walk to school every day.

entries.englishDefinition: An object, idea, action, or matter when its exact name is not given.

examples.english: Put your things in the bag.
The important thing is to keep trying.

entries.englishDefinition: An adult male person.

examples.english: The man at the counter helped me.
I saw a man waiting outside.
examples.chinese: 【男人】我看到一個男人在外面等。

entries.englishDefinition: An adult female person.

examples.english: The woman at the desk helped me.
I saw a woman waiting outside.
examples.chinese: 【女人】我看到一個女人在外面等。

entries.englishDefinition: A young person who is not yet an adult.

examples.english: The child is sleeping now.
examples.chinese: 【小朋友】小朋友現在正在睡覺。

examples.english: Each child received a small gift.
examples.chinese: 【小朋友】每個小朋友都收到一份小禮物。

entries.englishDefinition: A person you know well and like.

examples.english: I met an old friend for lunch.
examples.chinese: 【朋友】我和一位老朋友吃午飯。

examples.english: She is one of my best friends.
examples.chinese: 【朋友】她是我其中一位最好的朋友。

entries.englishDefinition: A group of people related to one another, especially parents and children.

examples.english: I spend Sunday with my family.
examples.chinese: 【家庭】我星期日和家人一起度過。

examples.english: Her family lives nearby.

entries.englishDefinition: The place where a person lives.

examples.english: I usually get home at seven.
I'll be home after six.
This apartment feels like home.
examples.chinese: 【家嘅感覺】這個單位讓我有家的感覺。

examples.english: After a few months, this city felt like home.
examples.chinese: 【家嘅感覺】住咗幾個月之後，呢個城市俾我有屋企嘅感覺。

entries.englishDefinition: A building where people live.

examples.english: They bought a small house in the countryside.
examples.chinese: 【房屋】他們在鄉郊買了一間小屋。

examples.english: Her house has a garden.

entries.englishDefinition: A part of a building enclosed by walls.

examples.english: This room is very bright.
Which room are we using today?
Is there room for one more person?
There isn't much room in my bag.

entries.englishDefinition: A particular area, position, or location.

examples.english: This is a nice place to eat.
examples.chinese: 【地方】這是一個吃飯的好地方。

examples.english: Put the bag back in its place.

entries.englishDefinition: A method, direction, or path.

examples.english: This is the easiest way to learn.
examples.chinese: 【方法】這是最容易的學習方法。

examples.english: Is there a quicker way to do this?
examples.chinese: 【方法】有冇快啲嘅方法做呢樣嘢？

examples.english: Can you show me the way to the station?
examples.chinese: 【路線】你可以告訴我去車站的路嗎？

examples.english: Do you know the way home?

entries.englishDefinition: The condition of a person's body and mind.

examples.english: Exercise is good for your health.
She is in good health.

entries.englishDefinition: Regular work that a person does to earn money.

examples.english: I started a new job last month.
examples.chinese: 【工作】我上個月開始了一份新工作。

examples.english: She is looking for a part-time job.

entries.englishDefinition: A place where children or students go to learn.

examples.english: The children walk to school every day.
Our school has a large library.
examples.chinese: 【學校】我們的學校有一個大型圖書館。

entries.englishDefinition: A person who studies at a school, college, or university.

examples.english: Each student has a notebook.
examples.chinese: 【學生】每個學生都有一本筆記簿。

examples.english: She is a university student.

entries.englishDefinition: A person whose job is to teach students.

examples.english: Our English teacher is very patient.
examples.chinese: 【老師】我們的英文老師很有耐性。

examples.english: The teacher explained the answer clearly.

entries.englishDefinition: Coins, notes, or digital value used to buy things.

examples.english: I need to save more money.
She paid the money at the counter.

entries.englishDefinition: Things that people or animals eat.

examples.english: This restaurant serves good food.
Do not leave food outside in hot weather.
examples.chinese: 【食物】天氣熱時不要把食物放在外面。

entries.englishDefinition: A clear liquid that people, animals, and plants need to live.

examples.english: Drink plenty of water every day.
The water in the bottle is cold.

entries.englishDefinition: A dark drink made from roasted coffee beans.

examples.english: I drink coffee every morning.
Would you like tea or coffee?

entries.englishDefinition: A drink made by putting dried tea leaves in hot water.

examples.english: Would you like a cup of tea?
I drink tea after lunch.

entries.englishDefinition: Food eaten at a particular time, such as breakfast or dinner.

examples.english: This is my first meal of the day.
We shared a simple meal at home.
examples.chinese: 【一餐】我們在家一起吃了一頓簡單的飯。

entries.englishDefinition: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

examples.english: I usually eat breakfast at seven.
We had eggs for breakfast.

entries.englishDefinition: A meal eaten around the middle of the day.

examples.english: I usually have lunch at one.
We went out for lunch together.

entries.englishDefinition: The main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening.

examples.english: We usually have dinner at seven.
She cooked dinner for the whole family.

entries.englishDefinition: A road vehicle with four wheels used for carrying a small number of people.

examples.english: We came here by car.
Her car is parked outside.

entries.englishDefinition: A large road vehicle that carries many passengers.

examples.english: I take the bus to work.
The next bus arrives in ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 【巴士】下一班巴士十分鐘後到。

entries.englishDefinition: A group of railway vehicles that carry people or goods.

examples.english: I take the train to work every day.
The train arrived five minutes late.

entries.englishDefinition: A car with a driver that passengers pay to take them somewhere.

examples.english: We took a taxi to the airport.
The hotel called a taxi for us.
examples.chinese: 【的士】酒店替我們召了一輛的士。

entries.englishDefinition: A vehicle with wings that flies through the air.

examples.english: Our plane leaves at ten.
I left my bag on the plane.

entries.englishDefinition: A hard surface built for vehicles to travel on.

examples.english: Be careful when you cross the road.
The road is busy during rush hour.
examples.chinese: 【道路】繁忙時間這條路交通很繁忙。

entries.englishDefinition: A public road in a town or city, usually with buildings along it.

examples.english: The restaurant is across the street.
This street is very busy in the morning.

entries.englishDefinition: A place where goods or services are sold.

examples.english: The shop opens at ten.
There is a small shop next to the station.
We went shopping after lunch.
I usually shop online.

entries.englishDefinition: A shop where goods are sold, or a place where things are kept.

examples.english: This store sells sports clothes.
Is the store still open?
Store the food in a cool place.
examples.chinese: 【存放】將啲食物放喺陰涼地方。

examples.english: Where do you store the extra chairs?
examples.chinese: 【存放】你哋將多出嚟啲櫈放喺邊？

entries.englishDefinition: A place where people pay to sit and eat meals.

examples.english: We booked a table at the restaurant.
examples.chinese: 【餐廳；食肆】我們在餐廳訂了座位。
examples.pattern: book a table at a restaurant

examples.english: This restaurant serves Italian food.
examples.chinese: 【餐廳；食肆】這間餐廳供應意大利菜。
examples.pattern: book a table at a restaurant

entries.englishDefinition: A business organization that sells goods or services.

examples.english: She works for a technology company.
examples.chinese: 【公司】她在一間科技公司工作。

examples.english: The company opened a new office.
examples.chinese: 【公司】公司開了一間新辦公室。

entries.englishDefinition: A room or building where people do business or professional work.

examples.english: My office is on the fifth floor.
She arrived at the office before nine.
examples.chinese: 【辦公室】她九點前到達辦公室。

entries.englishDefinition: A device for calling or messaging people; also to call someone.

examples.english: My phone battery is almost dead.
Have you seen my phone?
Please phone me when you arrive.
examples.chinese: 【打電話】你到咗請打電話俾我。

examples.english: I'll phone the restaurant to book a table.
examples.chinese: 【打電話】我會打電話去餐廳訂枱。

entries.englishDefinition: An electronic machine used to store and process information.

examples.english: I use a computer at work every day.
examples.chinese: 【電腦】我每天工作都使用電腦。

examples.english: My computer is running slowly today.
examples.chinese: 【電腦】我的電腦今天運行得很慢。

entries.englishDefinition: The global system that connects computers and devices to share information.

examples.english: I use the internet every day.
The internet connection is slow today.
examples.chinese: 【互聯網】今天的網絡連線很慢。

entries.englishDefinition: A piece of information sent or left for someone.

examples.english: I sent you a message this morning.
examples.chinese: 【訊息】我今天早上傳了訊息給你。

examples.english: Please leave a message after the beep.

entries.englishDefinition: A message sent electronically over the internet.

examples.english: I sent you an email this morning.
examples.chinese: 【電郵】我今天早上寄了一封電郵給你。

examples.english: Did you receive my email?
Please email me the document.
examples.chinese: 【發電郵】請用電郵將份文件傳俾我。

examples.english: Can you email me the address?
examples.chinese: 【發電郵】你可唔可以用電郵傳個地址俾我？

entries.englishDefinition: A sentence or request used to ask for information.

examples.english: Can I ask you a question?
examples.chinese: 【問題】我可以問你一個問題嗎？

examples.english: Read each question carefully.

entries.englishDefinition: A paper or electronic record that allows travel or entry.

examples.english: I need a ticket to the city center.
examples.chinese: 【車票；入場券】我要一張去市中心嘅車票。

examples.english: Can I buy a ticket online?
examples.chinese: 【車票；入場券】我可唔可以上網買飛？

entries.englishDefinition: A difficult situation or question that needs an answer or solution.

examples.english: We need to solve this problem today.
examples.chinese: 【問題】我們今天需要解決這個問題。

examples.english: There is a problem with my computer.

entries.englishDefinition: A thought, plan, or suggestion.

examples.english: That is a good idea.
She had an idea for the project.
examples.chinese: 【想法】她對這個項目有一個想法。

entries.englishDefinition: A description of real or imagined events.

examples.english: She told the children a story.
examples.chinese: 【故事】她跟小朋友說了一個故事。

examples.english: I read a short story before bed.
examples.chinese: 【故事】我睡前看了一篇短故事。

entries.englishDefinition: A cause or explanation for something.

examples.english: What is the reason for the delay?
She had a good reason to leave early.
examples.chinese: 【原因】她有充分理由提早離開。

entries.englishDefinition: What happens because of an action, test, or process.

examples.english: The test result was good.
We will know the result tomorrow.

entries.englishDefinition: A journey to a place and back, usually for a short time.

examples.english: We are planning a trip to Japan.
The school trip was very enjoyable.

entries.englishDefinition: An opportunity or possibility that something will happen.

examples.english: Give me a chance to explain.
This is your chance to ask questions.
examples.chinese: 【機會】呢個係你問問題嘅機會。

examples.english: There is a chance of rain tonight.
Is there a chance we can leave early?
examples.chinese: 【可能性】我哋有冇可能早啲走？

entries.englishDefinition: A piece or section of a whole.

examples.english: This is the most difficult part.
The machine has many small parts.
examples.chinese: 【部分】這部機器有很多小零件。

entries.englishDefinition: One of the surfaces or parts of something, especially left or right.

examples.english: Stand on the left side.
There are shops on both sides of the street.

entries.englishDefinition: A type of thing; also describes a caring and helpful person.

examples.english: What kind of food do you like?
This kind of bag is easy to carry.
It was kind of you to help.
examples.chinese: 【友善；好心】多謝你咁好人幫手。
examples.pattern: kind of someone to + base verb

examples.english: She was very kind to my children.
examples.chinese: 【友善；好心】佢對我啲小朋友好好。
examples.pattern: kind of someone to + base verb

entries.englishDefinition: An idea or detail; also to show a direction with a finger.

examples.english: That is a good point.
I understand your point.
Please point to the correct answer.
He pointed to the building across the road.
examples.chinese: 【指向】佢指住馬路對面嗰棟樓。

entries.englishDefinition: Something that is known to be true.

examples.english: This is an important fact.
Check the facts before you decide.

entries.englishDefinition: A word or group of words used to identify a person, place, or thing.

examples.english: Please write your name here.
examples.chinese: 【名字】請在這裏寫上你的名字。

examples.english: What is the name of this street?

entries.englishDefinition: A symbol or word used for counting or identifying something.

examples.english: Write your phone number here.
examples.chinese: 【數字】在這裏寫上你的電話號碼。

examples.english: Choose a number from one to ten.

entries.englishDefinition: A number of people or things together.

examples.english: We worked in a group of four.
A group of tourists entered the museum.
examples.chinese: 【小組】一群遊客進入了博物館。

entries.englishDefinition: The Earth and all the people and places on it.

examples.english: People around the world use the internet.
examples.chinese: 【世界】世界各地的人都使用互聯網。

examples.english: She wants to travel around the world.

entries.englishDefinition: An area of land with its own government and borders.

examples.english: Which country are you from?
They traveled to three countries last year.
examples.chinese: 【國家】他們去年去了三個國家旅行。

entries.englishDefinition: A large and important town.

examples.english: Hong Kong is a busy city.
examples.chinese: 【城市】香港是一個繁忙的城市。

examples.english: The city center is crowded today.

entries.englishDefinition: A particular part of a place or surface.

examples.english: This area is quiet at night.
Please keep this area clean.

entries.englishDefinition: A period of seven days.

examples.english: I work five days a week.
We will meet again next week.

entries.englishDefinition: One of the twelve periods that make up a year.

examples.english: I visit my parents once a month.
examples.chinese: 【月份】我每個月探望父母一次。

examples.english: Next month will be very busy.

entries.englishDefinition: A period of twelve months.

examples.english: I started this job last year.
She visits her family twice a year.

entries.englishDefinition: The day that is happening now.

examples.english: Are you free today?
Today is my first day at work.

entries.englishDefinition: The day after today.

examples.english: I will see you tomorrow.
Tomorrow is a public holiday.

entries.englishDefinition: The day before today.

examples.english: I saw her yesterday.
Yesterday was very busy.

entries.englishDefinition: The early part of the day, before noon.

examples.english: I exercise every morning.
It rained heavily this morning.

entries.englishDefinition: The part of the day between noon and evening.

examples.english: I have a meeting this afternoon.
We went shopping in the afternoon.

entries.englishDefinition: The later part of the day before bedtime.

examples.english: Are you free this evening?
We went for a walk in the evening.
examples.chinese: 【傍晚；晚上】我哋傍晚出去散咗陣步。

entries.englishDefinition: The dark part of each day.

examples.english: I work at night.
Did you sleep well last night?

entries.englishDefinition: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds.

examples.english: The bus will arrive in five minutes.
Wait here for a minute.

entries.englishDefinition: A period of sixty minutes.

examples.english: The journey takes one hour.
I study English for an hour every day.

entries.englishDefinition: A very short period of time.

examples.english: Wait a moment, please.
I need a moment to think.
examples.chinese: 【片刻】我需要一點時間想一想。

entries.englishDefinition: The experience of being alive or the way someone lives.

examples.english: How is life in your new home?
examples.chinese: 【生命；生活】搬咗屋之後生活點呀？

examples.english: Music is an important part of my life.
examples.chinese: 【生命；生活】音樂係我生活好重要嘅一部分。

entries.englishDefinition: The part of the body at the end of the arm.

examples.english: Wash your hands before eating.
He held the child's hand.

entries.englishDefinition: The top part of the body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.

examples.english: He hit his head on the shelf.
My head hurts after a long day.

entries.englishDefinition: The front part of the head, including the eyes, nose, and mouth.

examples.english: Wash your face before you go to bed.
He had a smile on his face.

entries.englishDefinition: The part of the body used for seeing.

examples.english: She has brown eyes.
My eyes feel tired after using the computer.
examples.chinese: 【眼睛】我用電腦後雙眼很疲倦。

entries.englishDefinition: The whole physical form of a person or animal.

examples.english: Exercise is good for your body.
Your body needs enough rest.
examples.chinese: 【身體】你的身體需要足夠休息。

entries.englishDefinition: New information about recent events.

examples.english: I read the news every morning.
Did you hear the good news?
examples.chinese: 【新聞】你有聽到這個好消息嗎？

entries.englishDefinition: The organ in the chest that pumps blood around the body.

examples.english: Exercise is good for your heart.
Her heart was beating quickly.

entries.englishDefinition: A single unit of language that has meaning.

examples.english: Write each new word in your notebook.
examples.chinese: 【單字】把每個新字寫在筆記簿裏。

examples.english: I do not know the meaning of this word.
examples.chinese: 【單字】我不知道這個字的意思。

entries.englishDefinition: A system of words used by people to communicate.

examples.english: English is an international language.
She can speak three languages.

entries.englishDefinition: A set of printed or digital pages containing words or pictures.

examples.english: I borrowed this book from the library.
She reads a book before bed.

entries.englishDefinition: A story shown using moving pictures, usually in a cinema or on a screen.

examples.english: We watched a movie last night.
examples.chinese: 【電影】我們昨晚看了一套電影。

examples.english: That movie was very funny.

entries.englishDefinition: Sounds made by voices or instruments for people to listen to.

examples.english: What kind of music do you like?
The music is too loud.

entries.englishDefinition: An activity or sport with rules, often played for fun or competition.

examples.english: We played a board game after dinner.
examples.chinese: 【遊戲】我們晚飯後玩桌上遊戲。

examples.english: Our team won the game.

entries.englishDefinition: An image, drawing, or photograph.

examples.english: Look at the picture on page ten.
The child drew a picture of a house.
examples.chinese: 【圖片】小朋友畫了一幅房屋的圖。

entries.englishDefinition: A picture made with a camera.

examples.english: Can you take a photo of us?
examples.chinese: 【相片】你可以幫我們拍一張相嗎？

examples.english: She showed me photos from her trip.

entries.englishDefinition: Things such as shirts, trousers, and dresses that people wear.

examples.english: These clothes are still wet.
I need to buy some new clothes.

entries.englishDefinition: An item worn on the foot for protection or comfort.

examples.english: I need a new pair of shoes.
Take off your shoes before entering.

entries.englishDefinition: A container made of soft material used for carrying things.

examples.english: My books are in this bag.
She bought a new shopping bag.

entries.englishDefinition: A small metal object used to open a lock, or an important part of something.

examples.english: I cannot find my house key.
Keep the key in a safe place.
examples.chinese: 【鎖匙】把鎖匙放在安全的地方。

entries.englishDefinition: A movable object used to open or close an entrance.

examples.english: Please close the door behind you.
Someone is knocking at the door.

entries.englishDefinition: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs.

examples.english: Dinner is on the table.
We sat around the table and talked.
examples.chinese: 【桌子】我們圍着桌子坐下談話。

entries.englishDefinition: A seat for one person, usually with a back.

examples.english: Please sit on this chair.
The chair is beside the table.

entries.englishDefinition: A piece of furniture used for sleeping.

examples.english: I went to bed before eleven.
The cat is sleeping on the bed.

entries.englishDefinition: A room containing a toilet, sink, or bath or shower.

examples.english: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
Please wash your hands in the bathroom.

entries.englishDefinition: A room where food is prepared and cooked.

examples.english: Dinner is ready in the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 【廚房】晚飯已經在廚房準備好。

examples.english: Please keep the kitchen clean.

entries.englishDefinition: The condition of the air outside, such as rain, wind, or temperature.

examples.english: The weather is nice today.
Check the weather before your trip.

entries.englishDefinition: Water that falls from clouds in drops.

examples.english: The rain stopped after lunch.
We waited for the rain to stop.
It may rain this afternoon.
It rained all afternoon.

entries.englishDefinition: The star that gives the Earth light and heat.

examples.english: The sun is very strong today.
We watched the sun set over the sea.
examples.chinese: 【太陽】我們看着太陽在海上落下。

entries.englishDefinition: The amount of money that something costs.

examples.english: What is the price of this shirt?
The price includes breakfast.

entries.englishDefinition: Work done for customers or the public.

examples.english: The hotel provides good service.
The service here is always friendly.
examples.chinese: 【服務】呢度啲服務一向都好親切。

examples.english: This bus service runs every ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 【交通服務／班次】呢條巴士線每十分鐘一班。

examples.english: There is no train service after midnight.
examples.chinese: 【交通服務／班次】午夜之後冇火車服務。

entries.englishDefinition: A record or service used by a person, especially online or at a bank.

examples.english: I created a new account on the app.
examples.chinese: 【帳戶】我在應用程式建立了新帳戶。

examples.english: Check your bank account balance.
examples.chinese: 【帳戶】查看你的銀行帳戶結餘。

entries.englishDefinition: Of high quality, pleasant, or suitable.

examples.english: This is a good restaurant.
That was a good meal.
She is good at English.
Are you good at cooking?

entries.englishDefinition: Not good, pleasant, or acceptable.

examples.english: The weather is bad today.
This is a bad time to call.
examples.chinese: 【差的】而家唔係打電話嘅好時候。

examples.english: I had a bad headache yesterday.
She has a bad cold.

entries.englishDefinition: Large in size or amount.

examples.english: They live in a big house.
This box is too big for the shelf.
examples.chinese: 【大的】這個箱太大，放不上層架。

entries.englishDefinition: Little in size, amount, or number.

examples.english: We live in a small apartment.
She ordered a small coffee.

entries.englishDefinition: Measuring a great distance from end to end or lasting a lot of time.

examples.english: It was a long journey.
She has long hair.

entries.englishDefinition: Having little length, height, or duration.

examples.english: The meeting was short.
He has short black hair.

entries.englishDefinition: Having a large distance from bottom to top or above the ground.

examples.english: The building is very high.
The shelf is too high for the child.
examples.chinese: 【高的】層架太高，小朋友碰不到。

entries.englishDefinition: Not high or below the usual level.

examples.english: The table is too low for this chair.
examples.chinese: 【低的】這張桌對這張椅子來說太低。

examples.english: The battery is low.

entries.englishDefinition: Having existed or lived for a long time.

examples.english: This building is very old.
My old phone still works.
I found an old photo in the drawer.
I keep my old school books.
My son is five years old.
How old is your daughter?

entries.englishDefinition: Having lived or existed for only a short time.

examples.english: She is still very young.
The young dog likes to play.

entries.englishDefinition: Recently made, bought, or begun.

examples.english: I bought a new phone yesterday.
examples.chinese: 【新的】我昨天買了一部新電話。

examples.english: She started a new job this month.
examples.chinese: 【新的】她今個月開始一份新工作。

entries.englishDefinition: Before the usual or expected time.

examples.english: I arrived at work early today.
The shop closes early on Sunday.
examples.chinese: 【早的】這間店星期日提早關門。

entries.englishDefinition: After the expected or usual time.

examples.english: The train was ten minutes late.
Do not stay up too late tonight.

entries.englishDefinition: Correct or on the side opposite to left.

examples.english: You gave the right answer.
Are you sure this is the right address?
Turn right at the next corner.
The bathroom is on your right.

entries.englishDefinition: Not correct or not suitable.

examples.english: That answer is wrong.
I got on the wrong bus.

entries.englishDefinition: Not different; exactly like another thing.

examples.english: We ordered the same meal.
These two bags are the same color.
examples.chinese: 【相同的】這兩個袋是同一種顏色。

entries.englishDefinition: Not the same as another person or thing.

examples.english: These two answers are different.
We tried three different restaurants.
examples.chinese: 【不同的】我們試了三間不同的餐廳。

entries.englishDefinition: Having great value, effect, or meaning.

examples.english: Sleep is important for good health.
This is an important meeting.

entries.englishDefinition: Able to happen or be done.

examples.english: Is it possible to change the booking?
Please come as early as possible.

entries.englishDefinition: Not able to happen or be done.

examples.english: It is impossible to finish today.
That sounds impossible.

entries.englishDefinition: Not difficult; requiring little effort.

examples.english: This exercise is easy.
The app is easy to use.
examples.chinese: 【容易的】這個應用程式很容易使用。

entries.englishDefinition: Difficult, solid, or requiring a lot of effort.

examples.english: The exam was quite hard.
It is hard to find a seat here.
She works hard every day.
He studies hard for every exam.
examples.chinese: 【努力】佢每次考試都好努力溫書。

examples.english: This bed is too hard.
The bread has gone hard.

entries.englishDefinition: Not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

examples.english: This question is difficult.
It was difficult to find the address.

entries.englishDefinition: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.

examples.english: The instructions are simple to follow.
She cooked a simple dinner.
examples.chinese: 【簡單的】她煮了一頓簡單的晚飯。

entries.englishDefinition: Certain that something is true or will happen.

examples.english: Are you sure this is the right address?
examples.chinese: 【肯定的】你肯定這是正確地址嗎？

examples.english: I am sure she will come.

entries.englishDefinition: Prepared for something to happen or be done.

examples.english: Dinner is ready.
Are you ready to leave?
examples.chinese: 【準備好的】你準備好出發了嗎？

entries.englishDefinition: Having a lot to do or full of activity.

examples.english: I am busy this afternoon.
The restaurant is very busy at lunchtime.
examples.chinese: 【忙碌的】餐廳午飯時間很繁忙。

entries.englishDefinition: Not costing money, not busy, or not controlled.

examples.english: The museum is free on Sundays.
examples.chinese: 【免費】博物館星期日免費入場。

examples.english: Children can enter for free.
Are you free this evening?
When are you free to talk?
You are free to leave now.
Feel free to use the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 【自由；獲准】你隨時都可以用廚房。

entries.englishDefinition: Containing as much as possible or having eaten enough.

examples.english: The bus is full.
The bottle is full of water.
I am full after dinner.
No more cake, thanks. I'm full.
examples.chinese: 【飽】唔使再俾蛋糕我喇，多謝，我飽喇。

entries.englishDefinition: Containing nothing.

examples.english: The bottle is empty.
There were many empty seats on the bus.

entries.englishDefinition: Having little or no light.

examples.english: It gets dark early in winter.
The room was too dark to read.

entries.englishDefinition: Not open or not available for business.

examples.english: The shop is closed today.
examples.chinese: 【關閉嘅；冇營業嘅】間舖今日冇開。

examples.english: Please keep the door closed.
examples.chinese: 【關閉嘅；冇營業嘅】請保持閂門。

entries.englishDefinition: Having a high temperature.

examples.english: The soup is still hot.
It is very hot outside today.

entries.englishDefinition: Having a low temperature.

examples.english: It is cold outside today.
The water is too cold to swim in.

entries.englishDefinition: Slightly hot in a pleasant way.

examples.english: The room is warm and comfortable.
Wear a warm jacket tonight.
examples.chinese: 【溫暖的】今晚穿一件保暖外套。

entries.englishDefinition: A little cold; also used informally to mean very good.

examples.english: The room is nice and cool.
It gets cool in the evening.
That is a cool idea.
Your new shoes look really cool.
Let the food cool before eating.
The soup needs time to cool.

entries.englishDefinition: Moving or happening quickly.

examples.english: This train is very fast.
He can run fast.

entries.englishDefinition: Moving or happening at a low speed.

examples.english: The traffic is very slow this morning.
My computer is slow today.
